glosses: monstrance (an ornamental, often precious receptacle, especially in the Roman Catholic Church, either open or with a transparent cover, in which the Eucharistic Host is placed for veneration)

examples.text: El sospechoso fue puesto bajo custodia.
examples.en: The suspect was taken into custody.

examples.text: Tom consiguió la custodia de su hijo.
examples.en: Tom got custody of his son.

examples.text: Tom perdió la custodia de sus hijos.
examples.en: Tom lost custody of his children.
